genesis.title: Mega Drive / Genesis six-button controller
genesis.note: The Mode button is on the back; use its binding in the list.

pce.title: PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16 · TurboPad
pce.note: Two-button pad shown. Six-button controls and pad mode are available in the list.

psx.title: PlayStation · DualShock
psx.note: L2 and R2 are behind the shoulders; configure them in the list. Click the center of a stick for L3 or R3.

n64.title: Nintendo 64 controller
n64.note: The Z trigger is on the back; configure it in the list.

vb.title: Virtual Boy controller
vb.note: The L and R triggers are on the back; configure them in the list.

nds.title: Nintendo DS · DS Lite
nds.note: L and R are behind the hinge; configure them in the list.

lynx.title: Atari Lynx
lynx.note: Both A/B pairs are available for the two holding orientations.

wsc.title: WonderSwan Color · SwanCrystal
wsc.note: Screen rotation is available in the binding list.

sms.title: Master System control pad
sms.note: Pause is on the console; configure it in the list.

atari2600.title: Atari 2600 · CX40 joystick
atari2600.note: Select, Reset, difficulty and color switches are on the console; configure them in the list.

atari7800.title: Atari 7800 · CX78 gamepad
atari7800.note: Select, Pause, Reset and difficulty switches are on the console; configure them in the list.

intellivision.title: Intellivision hand controller
intellivision.note: Other keypad numbers use the core’s on-screen keypad; its controls are in the list.
